title: The Machine Record: incidents involving commercial physical robots
description: Case metadata of The Machine Record, a public register of incidents involving commercial physical robots (robotaxis, delivery robots, warehouse and industrial machines, surgical systems, humanoids). Four tables: cases (one row per documented incident), timeline events, sources with tiers and archived copies, and links to NHTSA Standing General Order filings. Each case carries with a permanent case page that carries the timeline from first report to any recall, investigation, lawsuit or settlement, and the archived sources. Quarterly research releases with a codebook, annotation guidelines and known limitations; refreshed daily from the site's open API between releases. Not a safety rating: fleet sizes are not public.
